book-two: Cleveland has defenders now. That doesn’t mean they have everything figured out.

While Seth learns to control his strength and Jenny balances reporting with being a hero, Eleanor Blackwell promises the city free electricity. Her mysterious power source leads back to Dr. Daniel Orkleson—and an experiment he calls Skyfall.

Daniel sees power where others see people. His animated bear trap, Jaws O’ Death, still believes the next experiment will give him a body. To protect their friends and their city, the Defenders must discover what Daniel intends to take—and stop him before he throws the switch.
book-three: Laura Baxter cannot even sneeze without starting a fire. Flaming Head offers help—but a costume and target practice cannot give her ordinary life back.

When her anger turns toward the little flame who changed her life, Dr. Daniel Orkleson makes an offer: help him test a machine that could make Flaming Head helpless. With his floating, metal-jawed creation Jaws O’ Death at his side, the scientist known as Dork puts his plan in motion high above Cleveland.
Laura thinks she knows what she wants to see happen. But when her chance comes, she must decide how far she is willing to go.
book-four: An Army tank has vanished. A bank vault is missing. And Daniel Orkleson has a shrinking ray, a wounded ego, and a shelf picked out for Terminal Tower.

Super Zerdo, Pink Blur, Fist-O-Mite, and Inspector Billy must stop Dork before Cleveland’s skyline becomes his trophy collection. But Lava Lips is spitting fire, Jaws is spoiling for a fight, and Fist discovers that an old enemy no longer remembers him.
With Flaming Head missing, the Defenders must rely on one another—and leave the door open for an unlikely ally.
